title: Substitution continuation authority, unsupported opening rows, loader parity and corrected test gate
head: be24c225c00cf8c583bf7773ee124d354b91e88b

reviews.classification: historical dispatch / missing suppliers / scoped implementation evidence
reviews.disposition:
Historical implementation dispatch, not delivered coverage, under AD36/AD41/AD43. Preserve PC7–PC14, E1–E10, F/U/L/TSW joins and all five lane responsibilities: physical requirements/allocation; transformed preparation/demonstrated methods; observer recommendation and chosen stock; directional law/provenance; actual world-host/transaction integration and proof. Essential conditions cannot be averaged away; physical eligibility is distinct from a known recommendation. An exact descriptor, recipe stamp or ownership label does not by itself enforce product identity, units or foreign-law activation. Inert foreign ownership, actual costs/conversion and directional cases remain useful world-specific questions, not a universal chemistry ontology.

The later continuation paragraph explicitly supersedes the artificial percentage ceilings, finite-allowance requirement and AU7 usage stops. Do not revive37→42 percent as a current stop. It resumes existing lanes without adding chats; actual service limits, ownership, save privacy, scope and commit/push boundaries remain separate. Earlier exactly-five dispatch and lock/slot paragraphs preserve that wave's history, not evidence that named slots or workers remain active today. Guidance dispatched to all five is not evidence of implemented gameplay.

Keep producer responsibility separate: G5 vocabulary/lot facts, G3 stages, G2 allocation/fit; I5 owns actual integration rather than competing facts in every leaf. Already-present functionality, dependency ownership, evidence-blocked rows and concrete inapplicability have distinct dispositions. A first slice does not erase selected detail coverage, and schema/API observations are not automatically bugs. J1 natural obtain/compare/prepare/use/repeat, failure/recovery and persistence remain the original requested delivery distinctions, not newly completed tests. Current review reads the complete brief, not sibling implementation checkpoints, integration evidence or source. No present worker dispatch, lock acquisition, gameplay write or universal new completion gate follows.

reviews.classification: historical dispatch / missing suppliers / scoped implementation evidence
reviews.disposition:
Historical opening refinement, below its stated UIA-R1 floor, under AD36/AD42/AD43. Preserve the three held IDs and their source locators as retained rows with missing discovery and physical-support producers, not as playable actions hidden behind a timer. A row-generated object fact is not independent physical presence. Distinguish observation/discovery from actual command admission and settlement; known ordinary blockers can be disclosed while unobserved commands remain absent. Actual place/participant/time/object/knowledge support, not textual place similarity or waiting, is the named missing supplier.

All38 same-place mapped rows retain their distinct triage:28 different source-place strings, six unbound windows including the three held rows, three other unbound rows still available, and ten identical source-place strings. Text mismatch is not proof of different places and equality is not safety proof. Keep the remaining22 textually different mapped IDs and the three other unbound IDs in the original queue rather than declaring all38 reconciled by three annotations. Exact source/alias/mechanism review is not performed in this document-only pass.

The generator reapplies private annotations and rejects missing annotation file/ID before writing by default. Its explicit partial override records unmatched IDs; it does not silently adopt them. The rebuilt candidate proposed78 additional rows and was not adopted. Coverage of this CLI is not coverage of every manual pack-writing/replacement route. Four annotations and three held actions count different things. Hashes bind original inputs; current read does not regenerate the private pack.

Fresh desktop desk/clock persistence and a separately seeded active-story fixture have different proof. Provider/same-session transitions are synthetic; no actual mixed-clock activity or live expanded-panel auto-close was exercised. Separate HP clock check is not that missing mixed-clock journey. MCP frozen instrumented bundle differs from desktop browser bundle; the21 px fresh-state fixture is distinct from14 px earned actions. The Village away report is an earlier provenance gap: the later KJ1 receipt records gating the reproduced producer, without proving every historical instance erased or all L3/L7 issues closed. Private backup/evidence preservation and old temporary snapshot are not installation. No new source-scene, browser, private-pack or current-runtime proof is added here.

reviews.classification: historical dispatch / missing suppliers / scoped implementation evidence
reviews.disposition:
Historical behavior-preserving pack-loader slice under AD36/AD43. A projection-only registry installs a bundled plain-data JS pack while adapters preserve export names; no saved pack revision or new tick owner was added. Non-function export equality and JSON-round-trippability test different properties. The registry's loud dormant/error failure guards against silently installing an empty world, but does not establish every loaded definition's source fidelity. The six law/job/food/price lint records and T2/core-floor classification are representation/coverage claims, not a full playable Cyoria world.

Six-seed300-step simfuzz baseline/final equality and normalized browser digests are bounded regression comparisons. Removing per-run saved timestamps, RNG seeds and UUIDs means normalized digest parity is not literal complete-save byte equality or proof of all random outcomes. The browser boots and talks to an elder; it never reaches Cyoria. Preserve the explicit WA19 browser-journey backlog despite engine/native-binding checks. The npm-test cell points to another report without a result/count here; do not invent a green aggregate from this checkpoint.

Pack revision pinning WA10/WAC5 deliberately remains absent to retain save shape, and IDs/locations/footprints/text still in the ID module remain a follow-up. Keeping a JSON-round-trippable JS module reflects the then scanner's import support, not a universal architecture ban on JSON. The old rebuild-after-merge instruction, branch and dist state are historical, not present execution authority. This whole-file content review reads neither linked test/report/source bodies nor a current browser artifact; it adds no gameplay, installation or persistence proof.

reviews.classification: historical dispatch / missing suppliers / scoped implementation evidence
reviews.disposition:
Historical repaired gate and concrete correctness findings under AD36/AD42/AD43. Preserve each of the five classifications: stale reverse-patch feature detection; redundant boot workload under load; stale local-clock precision expectation; real observer seam violation; missing perspective metadata. Current-source native integration replaced forcing an obsolete CR2 patch. The observer repair retains the single adapter read and capability projection instead of expanding the allowlist. Exact minute display was retained rather than weakening the clock to satisfy an old assertion.

The shorter authored one-minute card fixture exposed a real missing within-day settlement trigger hidden by a whole-day wait. Existing admitted window computation, authoritative cast sync and wait splitting supply the repair without a second clock or marker schema. Pending reload, settled literal import, tampered markers/effects and no-early effect are distinct checks. The production story pack had zero standalone cards at that time, so synthetic native card correctness is not delivered story content or volume-start semantics. Old settled markers must not replay; skipping to a volume still needs valid prior history.

The4913/4914 intermediate diagnostic is superseded by the final4914/4914 run at its stated inputs; overlapping focused counts are not added. About150 versus72 seconds under different load is not a controlled speed benchmark or proof that the original timeout was a gameplay hang. Twelve native UI journey checks predate the final card fix and are reused for unchanged handlers, while two final-bundle lead/Beside checks cover the changed entry/observer seam. They are not a final-bundle fresh full-journey rerun. The live-game-or-PLAY lifecycle repair and no-font-ready screenshot retry are harness changes, not game actions or proof of every remote font loaded.

Volume maps/presets/content-loading ideas remain VG1–VG6 proposals in the campaign owner with their existing triggers. This gate repair implements no volume-start feature, new source coverage, later story mechanism or L2b combat. Human review is optional. This reconciliation reads the entire repair receipt, not private proof, source, tests or captures today, and adds no new runtime/build/suite/installation evidence.
